notes.title: Build 34 release notes
notes.notes:
Good news everyone: Brainmelter Deluxe is now free! As well, I've just patched it with a few quality of life updates: 

Level borders are now unlit, thus making the level layout easier to read at a glance

The player look left/right idle animation has been removed, as this was making it difficult to tell which you way you were looking when standing still

Fix for extreme screenshake at higher frame rates
